notes: ACCESS: tier (a) direct HTTP fetch (curl_cffi impersonate=chrome) throughout - Shopify store, robots.txt is generic 'User-agent: * / Allow: /' with no Claude/anthropic-specific disallow, so tier (a) was permitted and worked fully; no escalation to Playwright/Chrome needed. TREE: union of homepage mega-menu (9 top menus: New, Accessories, Kitchen, Wall Decor, Furniture, Lighting, Gifts, Garden, Sale, Inspiration - fetched and parsed raw HTML) plus full collections sitemap (sitemap_collections_1.xml, 335 collection URLs) keyword-scanned for textile/storage terms; every candidate collection page was fetched individually and its h1 and mega-menu placement checked to confirm node identity. QTY: each collection's own server-rendered 'N Result(s)' text (class filter-bar__results-count, attribute data-results-count) was used, cross-checked against an embedded page-state field 'products_count:' which matched exactly in every case (including 0-product collections, confirmed by a second independent check: zero /products/ links present besides the site-wide gift-voucher upsell link). Product cards themselves are lazy-loaded via a client-side filter app (spf) and not present in raw HTML, so titles could not be read via tier (a), but the count elements are Liquid/server-rendered and reliable, so no Playwright escalation was needed for qty either. EXCLUDED: Bathroom hub collection (44 items, room roll-up mixing bathroom mirrors/storage/decor/textiles - excluded per room-name-alone rule, since the genuine textile leaf 'Bath Mats & Towels' already exists separately under Soft Furnishings); Placemats & Coasters (2 items, sits under Kitchen menu > Tableware, mixes non-textile coasters with placemats, primary site classification is Kitchen & Dining not Soft Furnishings - excluded, out of scope for both Textile and Storage); Pet Beds & Blankets (pet-specific, excluded per pet rule); Drinks Trolleys & Bar Shelves/Serving Carts (serving/dining furniture, not storage, per storage rule 20); Chest of Drawers, Sideboards & Cabinets, Bookcases-type items (Furniture, excluded). Doormats(3)/Floor Rugs(4)/Sheepskin Rugs(0) are standalone collections found only via the sitemap (not linked from the live mega-menu, and not linked from the Doormats & Rugs page itself either) with distinct product counts smaller than and non-additive to the mega-menu-linked 'Doormats & Rugs' (14) collection, so they were kept as separate rows rather than folded into it (different listing URLs = different products per duplicate rule), flagged MEDIUM confidence for manual review since they are not currently reachable through on-site navigation. Shelving & Storage (24) sits in the Furniture mega-menu (not a dedicated Storage/Organization section) so it is a genuine storage/furniture boundary case per storage.md SS18/21; kept as Storage at MEDIUM confidence with a review flag since product-level content could not be verified without a render pass. No duplicate rows emitted; no product-detail/search/View-All/Collection promotional URLs used.
